en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a large wooden bath hotel building on a hill above a river or pond, surrounded by trees and landscaped paths. The architecture features towers with domed roofs and many windows with awnings. Printed captions at the bottom read "Badhotellet." and "Ronneby Brunn." There is cursive handwriting in a European script along the right margin and bottom.
